title: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
description:
You are given a sorted array of lowercase characters and a target character.

Your task is to find the smallest character in the array that is strictly greater than the target character.

If no such character exists, return the first character of the array (wrap-around behavior).

You must read input from standard input and print the result accordingly.
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n — the number of characters.
The second line contains n space-separated lowercase characters.
The third line contains the target character.
output_format: Print a single character representing the answer.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 10000
letters[i] is a lowercase English letter.
letters is sorted in non-decreasing order.
letters contains at least two distinct characters.
target is a lowercase English letter.
